output.brief:
The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Build 7.4.0 already crashed at about 2% on 2–3 September, before the flag ramp, while 7.3.2 stayed at about 0.7%. Only 7.4.0 users can have the flag, so the flag group is simply the 7.4.0 group. Within 7.4.0, flag-on users crash 2.10% of sessions against 1.98% for the random holdout. That 0.12-point difference is within noise. Device memory mix and usage levels are the same across the groups, so neither explains the gap. The largest crash cluster, 41% of events, is a native crash in the upgraded Pixelda image library on HEIF decoding. It first appeared on 2 September and is absent from 7.3.2. The app store's own crash counts, which are separate from the crash-reporting SDK, show the same gap, so it isn't a reporting artifact. The 9 September sync-service deployment did not move 7.3.2's rate.

Don't turn off the flag and ship 7.4.0 to 100%: that would spread the real Pixelda crash. Hold the rollout at 25% and fix the Pixelda crash first. Keep the flag holdout running, and widen it if you want an answer sooner, to settle whether the flag adds a small effect. I'm fairly confident in this, and the flag's own effect remains open.
